Subject: ACME POC: Integration & Success Criteria

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed plan for the 2-week POC so we have alignment before Rishi and the engineering team start integrating: 

Goals / success criteria (please confirm):
- Generate production-like responses for our support triage workflow with >= 85% accuracy on intent classification across the 3 sampled intents.
- Average tail latency < 300ms for single-turn text generation at 512 tokens under expected trial throughput (~30 req/s).
- Embeddings-based similarity retrieval precision >= 0.88 on the 500-sample validation set.
- No unplanned PII exposure in model outputs (we'll run the red-team promptset).

Proposed POC scope / timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): SE workshop and environment provisioning (API keys, test dataset ingestion).
- Week 1: Integration + baseline tests (streaming enabled for inference, embedding index tests).
- Week 2: Quality tuning, run evals, finalize success metrics and next steps.

Owners / asks:
- ACME: provide 2 example datasets (support transcripts + internal KB) and confirm legal contact for data access (Priya).
- Redwood SE (Rishi): run integration workshop and share integration checklist + SDK samples.
- Redwood AE (me): coordinate milestones, billing/procurement touchpoints.

Attachments: redwood_poc_scope.pdf (scope + MOP), redwood_api_quickstart.pdf (API quickstart).

Next steps: Can you confirm the success criteria above and share the datasets by EOD Monday? Once confirmed, Rishi will schedule the 90-minute integration workshop.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Sam —

Thanks — quick technical answers and an integration plan. TL;DR: streaming + tool calling supported; data residency options available for trial (us-east-1). Full checklist attached (integration_checklist.csv).

Integration notes:
- SDKs: We support official SDKs (Python/Node) and direct REST. Quickstart: refer to redwood_api_quickstart.pdf and https://docs.redwood.com/poc/integration.
- Auth: Generate a trial API key scoped to the ACME POC project. We'll provide keys and a short-lived team token for ingestion.
- Endpoints:
  - /v1/generate for standard generation (supports streaming: server-sent events and WebSocket).
  - /v1/embeddings for dense vectors (batch endpoints supported).
  - /v1/tool-calls to configure deterministic tool invocation hooks (we can wire your KB search + ticket-create as callable tools).
- Streaming behavior: chunked SSE with event: data for partial tokens; ensure client reconnect logic (we include examples).
- Tool calling: define tool schema (name, input_schema, output_schema). We recommend using the explicit tool-calling mode for deterministic steps (search -> rerank -> ticket create).
- Rate limits & batching: default trial limits are 60 req/s with burst to 120; we can increase if needed for benchmarking. Use batching on /v1/embeddings to reduce cost.
- KV cache + prefix caching: If you plan multi-turn sessions, enable prefix-based KV cache to reduce latency.
- Telemetry/data residency: For the POC we'll host the project in us-east-1; logs and ephemeral telemetry for inference tracing are retained for 30 days and stored in the region. Persistent artifacts (embeddings) will be stored in your project bucket in us-east-1. Compliance can request a SOC2 cover note; I can provide the data flow chart.

Sample curl (generation streaming SSE):

curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate?stream=true \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-2-small\",\"input\":\"Summarize the ticket: ...\",\"max_tokens\":256}'

Next steps from SE side:
- I will run the 90-minute integration workshop (propose Tue 2026-03-30 10:00-11:30 PT).
- Provide an integration_checklist.csv and a short sample repo for streaming + tool calling.
- Confirm final trial quota and provision project-scoped API keys once datasets are uploaded.

Let me know if you need wireframes/sample payloads for the tool-call schemas — happy to draft one before the workshop.

—Rishi
